messages:
maria: quick sync — we need a decision on quota attribution when X-Client-ID is missing. options: signed header, cookie, UA-derived heuristic, or tenant default. leaning signed header + cookie fallback for web. thoughts?

sam: signed header is preferred. without signing we open spoofing risk. need signer at the edge and verifier in the gateway.

ken: agree. also think we should emit telemetry for the decision path (signed|cookie|ua|default) so we can measure mismatch. add a metric like quota.attribution.path.

jess: console UX: expose a per-tenant toggle for allowing UA-fallback and show an audit row when fallback is used. also an opt-in flag for signed-header enforcement.

sam: impl notes — propose X-Route-Signature header: "sha256=<hex>". edge generates HMAC over "client_id|ts" with tenant key. gateway verifies TTL and HMAC. example:```js
// pseudo
const payload = `${headers['x-client-id']}|${headers['x-ts']}`
const ok = verifyHMAC(tenantKey, payload, headers['x-route-signature'])
```
If ok -> attribute to x-client-id, else continue fallback chain.

ken: mobile apps rarely have cookies, so cookie fallback is web-only. for mobile enforce signed header or require client id inside auth token. add SDK guidance.

jess: rollout plan in console: default = off. allow enabling per-tenant. add telemetry dashboard showing how often each fallback path runs and quota attribution mismatches. also add a warning banner when tenant enables UA fallback (due to spoof risk).

sam: one more risk: UA heuristics can collide (multiple SDKs share UA). if we use UA-derived as last resort we should tag attribution confidence low and not count toward strict quota throttling without grace.

maria: good point. treat UA-derived as advisory — only for best-effort accounting, not hard enforcement. enforcement order: signed header (strong) -> cookie (web) -> auth-token embedded client id -> UA heuristic (advisory) -> tenant default.

ken: tests: gateway unit test for signature verification, integration test hitting edge signer + gateway verifier, and canary with debug logs turned on. also add a tracing tag routing.client_source.

jess: UI tasks: toggle + rollout slider (0-100%) so we can canary enable for a subset of tenant traffic. show last 24h fallback counts.

sam: I'll write a short RFC for the HMAC format and key rotation model. include example curl and verification pseudocode.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy of gateway verifier to gateway-v3 at 03:00 UTC. healthchecks: 200 on /health + quota.attribution.mismatch < 0.1% for 48h.

maria: action items — PR for gateway verifier (sam), edge signer (ken), console toggle + rollout UI (jess), telemetry + dashboard (maria). timeline: aim for canary next Tuesday, 5% for 48h then ramp if metrics look good. :thumbsup:

sam: +1, I'll include fallback flow diagrams in the RFC.

ken: I'll update SDK docs and mobile guidance.

jess: I'll prototype UI mock and share in #design in the morning.

maria: thanks all. we'll sync in the weekly platform sync to confirm canary window.
